# Upgrade Stripe versions (Stripe)

Step-by-step help upgrading Stripe API versions, SDKs, Stripe.js and webhooks.

- Source: https://github.com/stripe/ai
- SKILL.md: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stripe/ai/main/skills/upgrade-stripe/SKILL.md
- Author: Stripe
- License: MIT
- Page: https://commandvault.ai/commands/upgrade-stripe-versions-stripe-86fe6e6d

Explains how Stripe API versioning works and guides an upgrade: choosing a target version, updating server SDKs, Stripe.js and mobile SDKs, moving webhook endpoints, and testing the change safely before rollout. It includes an upgrade checklist. Guidance only, no scripts.

**Try asking:**
- "Upgrade our Stripe API version to the latest"
- "Bump stripe-node and fix whatever breaks"
- "Plan the webhook endpoint upgrade"
